findings.title: As-delivered tree has no bundle/atlas outputs: menus and dialogs show raw bundle keys (campaign.select, campaign.none) and renderer uses placeholder quads
findings.expected: Java: localized menu/dialog text ('Select Starting Campaign', 'Database') and textured menu background / world rendering
findings.actual: Godot after the 18:22 mind-tools migrate: assets/locales and assets/sprites/sprites.atlas.json absent; log '[assets] ready ok=false pages=0 regions=0'; dialog title/description show campaign.select/campaign.none; '[W] MindWorldRenderer: atlas manifest unavailable; using placeholder quads' and 'menu background 8211 tiles missing regions'. Running the canonical `mind-tools pack` regenerates the outputs but its pack_pipeline wipes assets/sprites first (fs::remove_dir_all(out_dir)), deleting the vendored loose sprites (planets/, space.png, error.png, logo.png, ...), so migrate+pack cannot currently leave both the generated outputs and the vendored loose art in the tree.
findings.repro: launch res://scenes/game.tscn from the as-delivered working tree (no assets/locales + no assets/sprites/sprites.atlas.json) > Play > Campaign
notes: Evaluator restored a workable tree to verify EV-0011: ran `cargo run -p mind-tools -- pack` (log pack.log) then re-copied the 13 vendored loose sprites from ../Mindustry and sha256-verified them against build/assets/migration_manifest.json; no game code/scene/config touched. migrate.rs does a clean-mirror wipe; pack_pipeline.rs::pack wipes assets/sprites before writing pages. A robust fix must make the migrate->pack flow preserve the loose sprites (or load them from a non-generated location).
